dog.description_text:
🌼💕 MEET DAISY! 💕🌼

🐶 Female🎂 Age: 10 weeks
Weight: Approximately 7 lbs.

Don't let those four little pounds fool you—Daisy may be tiny, but she's got an adventurous spirit and plenty of opinions! 😂🌼

Daisy is a curious little girl who loves checking out what's happening around her. When she's awake, she's ready to explore and see what the world has to offer.

But Daisy also understands something many of us could learn from:

A good nap is VERY important. 😴😂
dog.name: DAISY
